name: Naru
title: Orbital Search Team
description: An intern of the Orbital Search Team of Polaris. She dreams of a future where she can perfectly observe the future through equations she devised herself.
introduction:
An trainee Observer undergoing dispatch training with the Orbital Search Team.

An ambitious figure who constantly declares her goal of becoming the top authority like Alicia, the ruler of NOA, and a self-proclaimed <color=#2A80D8>one and only genius</color>.
Naru's goal is to complete a self-devised equation and create a revolutionary new theory capable of completely changing people's lives.

However, those around her call her <color=#2A80D8>"a walking Star of Calamity"</color> because every organization she has trained with has suffered a major accident, and even the smallest issue that passes through Naru's hands often snowballs into devastating consequences.
